notes.title: V1.6.6 New Rule Variants for Rummy, Blackjack, and Others
notes.content:
Blackjack
+ Splitting can be enabled in the rules

Twenty-One
+ Bugfix: Dealer rotation every x rounds did not work

Rummy

+ Undo button to correct the current move
+ Bugfixes discarding with right mouse button, jokers scoring

Doppelkopf (Double head)

notes.title: Free Playtest for Classic Card Games 3D (Version 1.5.8)
notes.content:
A playtest for version 1.5.8 of Classic Card Games 3D is now available. This beta version introduces new rule options:


 Blackjack: Splitting hands is now possible.
 Rummy: Multiple sets or sequences can be combined during the initial meld to meet the minimum point requirement. Additionally, card values, number of cards, and other rules can be customized.

The playtest will be open for a few days and offers a preview of the major update planned for Q1 2025.

notes.title: Skat 3D Premium released!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33865336/77aaffa19b20f43fcc8ed9f72e796c924550c7e1.jpg


Skat 3D Premium is now available
The most popular German traditional Card Game Skat is part of this SP collection - which are new Premium features?

- Multiplayer: network game and online game to play in the community, with friends or family
- Animated Tutorial: Step by step you learn the rules of the game Skat
- More game variants: additional rule variants such as Pub rules
- Higher A.I. and playing comfort: optimized user interface
- More achievements of Skat
- Several camera perspectives

About the game
Skat is a trick-taking card game with 3 players very similar to Spades, and national game of Germany. All popular rule variants and very powerful but adjustable AI opponents are waiting for all who want to play this traditional card game. Game rules can be learned in the animated Tutorial.

Every single round, first the one who plays against 2 others has to be determined. This is done by the auction (German: "Reizen") meaning betting and competing, player with strongest bet may define the Trump suit - but plays against 2 other players!
